From c7f7e2feffb0294302041507dfd5fc15f01afccc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Lyude <cpaul@redhat.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jun 2016 11:58:15 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915/fbc: Disable on HSW by default for now

>From https://bugs.freedesktop.org/show_bug.cgi?id=96461 :

This was kind of a difficult bug to track down. If you're using a
Haswell system running GNOME and you have fbc completely enabled and
working, playing videos can result in video artifacts. Steps to
reproduce:

- Run GNOME
- Ensure FBC is enabled and active
- Download a movie, I used the ogg version of Big Buck Bunny for this
- Run `gst-launch-1.0 filesrc location='some_movie.ogg' ! decodebin !
  glimagesink` in a terminal
- Watch for about over a minute, you'll see small horizontal lines go
  down the screen.

For the time being, disable FBC for Haswell by default.

Stefan Richter reported kernel freezes (no video artifacts) when fbc
is on.  (E3-1245 v3 with HD P4600; openbox and some KDE and LXDE
applications, thread begins at https://lkml.org/lkml/2016/4/26/813).
We also got reports from Steven Honeyman on openbox+roxterm.

v2 (From Paulo):
  - Add extra information to the commit message
  - Add Fixes tag
  - Rebase

Bugzilla: https://bugs.freedesktop.org/show_bug.cgi?id=96461
Bugzilla: https://bugs.freedesktop.org/show_bug.cgi?id=96464
Fixes: a98ee79317b4 ("drm/i915/fbc: enable FBC by default on HSW and BDW")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Reviewed-by: Paulo Zanoni <paulo.r.zanoni@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Lyude <cpaul@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: Paulo Zanoni <paulo.r.zanoni@intel.com>
Link: http://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/1465487895-7401-1-git-send-email-cpaul@redhat.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_fbc.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_fbc.c
index ecabd59ffbaf..a19944b6dc25 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_fbc.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_fbc.c
@@ -818,8 +818,7 @@ static bool intel_fbc_can_choose(struct intel_crtc *crtc)
 {
 	struct drm_i915_private *dev_priv = crtc->base.dev->dev_private;
 	struct intel_fbc *fbc = &dev_priv->fbc;
-	bool enable_by_default = IS_HASWELL(dev_priv) ||
-				 IS_BROADWELL(dev_priv);
+	bool enable_by_default = IS_BROADWELL(dev_priv);
 
 	if (intel_vgpu_active(dev_priv)) {
 		fbc->no_fbc_reason = "VGPU is active";
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_fbc.c`**
   - The condition for enabling FBC (Frame Buffer Compression) by default has been modified. 
   - The line that previously allowed FBC to be enabled by default for Haswell (IS_HASWELL(dev_priv)) has been removed. 
   - Now, FBC will only be enabled by default for Broadwell (IS_BROADWELL(dev_priv)).

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in the `intel_fbc.c` file directly addresses the bug reported in the associated Bugzilla links, which indicated issues with video artifacts and kernel freezes when FBC was enabled on Haswell systems. By disabling FBC by default for Haswell, the patch aims to mitigate these issues until a more stable solution can be implemented. The change reflects a temporary measure to improve system stability and user experience on affected hardware.

                         IS_BROADWELL(dev_priv);
```
Reason:

bool enable_by_default = IS_BROADWELL(dev_priv);
```
Reason:
This change restricts the default enabling of FBC to only Broadwell systems, thereby preventing the instability and video artifacts associated with Haswell systems when FBC is enabled.
